settings.intro: Strong currents, remote islands and powerful GT fishing at the meeting of two seas.

settings.heading: Explore the fishing.
settings.intro: Fish strong currents where the Red Sea meets the Gulf of Aden. Explore GT popping, jigging and shore fishing around Djibouti’s remote islands and reefs.

settings.heading: Goubet and the islands
settings.text: The Strait of Goubet, Mucha and Maskali Islands, and the Seven Brothers feature in the original liveaboard itinerary.

settings.heading: Popping and jigging
settings.text: Target giant trevally with heavy casting tackle. Jigging and lighter fishing expand the options as conditions allow.

settings.heading: Shore fishing
settings.text: The Seven Brothers also offer shore casting for GT and other species. Ask the team about current routes and conditions.

settings.heading: Plan your next trip.
settings.text: Tell us your preferred window. Our team will confirm current departures and arrangements.
